description: Elongated segment with volume 620 Å³ but all 5 docking poses for the candidate ligand cluster within RMSD 0.3 Å and cover only 45% of the segment volume.

expected_decision.rationale: Poses are too clustered for an elongated segment. Increase docking diversity (more global search, looser RMSD clustering) to explore alternative orientations before assuming the ligand is wrong.

notes: If diversity budget is exhausted, narrow_docking_search around the under-covered tail is acceptable.
